title: Kabbalat Shabbat
attributionNote: Authorship follows the Sefaria catalogue record for this work. Where a text is traditionally attributed or collectively compiled, the library does not assert a single author beyond the source's own metadata.
description: A series of psalms often recited or sung at the beginning of Friday night prayers as a way of welcoming in Shabbat. Complete Liturgy text imported from Sefaria; the exact edition and licence are shown with each version.
historicalContext: Liturgy is the recited text of prayer and ritual. Its wording varies by rite and community, so each imported text names its rite and edition instead of being harmonised into a single service.
availabilityNote: Imported from Sefaria. Version, source and licence are recorded per edition.
